metadata.source: International Trade Centre (ITC), Geneva / World Customs Organization (WCO) / Department of Commerce, New Delhi
statutory_framework: Customs Act, 1962 (Section 28DA - Procedure relating to Origin of Goods)
Customs Administration of Rules of Origin under Trade Agreements Rules, 2020 (CAROTAR, 2020 - Notification No. 81/2020-Customs N.T.)
WCO Guidelines on Certification of Origin and Verification
Foreign Trade Policy 2023 (Chapter 2 - General Provisions Regarding Imports and Exports)
metadata.carotar_key_mandate: Under Section 28DA and CAROTAR 2020, an importer claiming preferential tariff treatment must possess origin-related details (Form I) demonstrating production process and value addition, and can no longer rely solely on a Certificate of Origin (COO).

agreements.name: India-UAE Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (CEPA)
agreements.origin_rule_standard: CTSH + 40% Regional Value Content (RVC) or Specific Product Rule (PSR)
agreements.cumulation: Bilateral Cumulation permitted between India and UAE
agreements.coverage: Over 80% tariff lines duty-free immediately; 90% phased over 5-10 years

agreements.name: India-Australia Economic Cooperation and Trade Agreement (ECTA)
agreements.coverage: Australia eliminated tariffs on 100% of Indian tariff lines from Day 1

agreements.name: ASEAN-India Free Trade Agreement (AIFTA / CECA)
agreements.cumulation: Regional Cumulation across ASEAN Member States and India
agreements.coverage: Substantial tariff reduction on manufacturing and agro commodities

agreements.name: India-Japan Comprehensive Economic Partnership Agreement (IJCEPA)
agreements.origin_rule_standard: CTSH + 35% Qualifying Value Content (QVC) or CTH
agreements.coverage: Covers ~90% of tariff lines; zero duty on pharma, textiles, marine products

agreements.name: South Asian Free Trade Area (SAFTA)
agreements.partner: SAARC Countries (Bangladesh, Bhutan, Maldives, Nepal, Pakistan, Sri Lanka)
agreements.origin_rule_standard: CTH + 40% Domestic Value Addition (30% for LDCs)
agreements.cumulation: SAARC Regional Cumulation with 50% regional content (20% domestic)
agreements.coverage: Concession schedules for Developing and LDC member countries

agreements.name: India-Mercosur Preferential Trade Agreement
agreements.cumulation: Bilateral Cumulation between Mercosur and India
agreements.coverage: Margin of Preference (MoP) ranging from 10% to 20% on 450+ tariff lines

products.name: Articles of Jewellery & Parts Thereof, of Precious Metal (Gold / Diamond Jewellery)
products.description: Zero customs duty in UAE for Indian gold jewellery (saving 5% MFN duty). Requires minimum 3% value addition over raw gold bullion and CTSH shift.
products.carotar_risk_tier: HIGH (Precious metals subject to strict melting and alloy assay audits to prevent round-tripping).

products.name: T-shirts, Singlets and Other Vests, Knitted or Crocheted, of Cotton
products.description: Australia eliminated 5% MFN tariff immediately under ECTA. Levels the playing field against duty-free competitors like Bangladesh and Vietnam.
products.carotar_risk_tier: LOW-MODERATE (Origin of raw cotton and yarn spinning documentation required under Section 28DA).

products.name: Other Parts and Accessories of Bodies for Motor Vehicles
products.description: Preferential tariff of 5% vs standard 15% MFN, yielding a 10% duty arbitrage advantage across automotive supply chains in Southeast Asia.
products.carotar_risk_tier: MODERATE (Sub-tier raw steel and electronics BOM traceability required).

products.name: Medicaments Consisting of Mixed or Unmixed Products for Therapeutic Uses (Generic Formulations)
products.roo_criterion: CTH or CTSH + 40% Qualifying Value Content (QVC)
products.ctc_rule: CTH (Change in Tariff Heading from API HS 2933)
products.description: Zero duty entry into Japan under CEPA. Requires transformation from chemical APIs (Chapter 29) to finished dosage formulations (Chapter 30).
products.carotar_risk_tier: LOW (GMP batch manufacturing records and active pharmaceutical ingredient synthesis evidence).

products.name: Sacks and Bags (including cones) of Polymers of Ethylene
products.ctc_rule: CTSH (Change in Tariff Sub-Heading from raw polymer resin 3901)
products.description: Immediate duty elimination in UAE. Virgin/recycled polymer compounding and extrusion within India qualifies under CTSH + 40% VA.
products.carotar_risk_tier: MODERATE (Requires virgin polymer import invoice verification to verify origin of base granule).

products.name: Crude Soya-bean Oil, Whether or Not Degummed
products.roo_criterion: Wholly Obtained or 40% Domestic Value Addition
products.description: 10% Margin of Preference (MoP) on Indian customs tariff, reducing effective basic customs duty from 35.0% to 31.5% for Mercosur origin crushings.
products.carotar_risk_tier: HIGH (Strict origin tracing of oilseed cultivation and extraction mill certificates).

section_28da_compliance.title: Possession of Origin Information (Form I)
section_28da_compliance.requirement: The importer must possess sufficient information regarding origin criteria, regional value content calculation, and manufacturing process prior to filing the Bill of Entry.

section_28da_compliance.title: Due Diligence on Certificate of Origin (COO)
section_28da_compliance.requirement: Verify that COO is issued by authorized issuing agency with valid digital signature/seal, correct origin criteria code ('WO', 'PSR', 'RVC'), and unbroken invoice correlation.

section_28da_compliance.title: Direct Consignment & Non-Manipulation Rule
section_28da_compliance.requirement: Goods must be transported directly from the exporting contracting party. If transshipped through a third country, must provide through Bill of Lading and Certificate of Non-Manipulation from transit port customs.

section_28da_compliance.title: 5-Year Record Retention Mandate
section_28da_compliance.requirement: All origin supporting documents, bills of materials, supplier declarations, and costing sheets must be retained for at least 5 years from the date of filing the Bill of Entry.

section_28da_compliance.title: Statutory Show Cause Notice (SCN) Risk
section_28da_compliance.requirement: Failure to provide origin verification within 10 working days can lead to suspension of preferential tariff treatment and demand for full MFN duty plus interest under Section 28.
